annotations.title: Rename a workspace or change its timezone

description: Rename the workspace, change its timezone (an IANA name such as America/New_York), or turn Google Analytics link tagging on or off (utm_tags). Posts with a time still ahead keep their clock time: 7:00 PM in the old zone becomes 7:00 PM in the new one, and one whose new time has already passed waits for a new time. A post with its own time zone (post_schedule timezone) keeps its moment. Published posts stay as they were. Agents get a confirm_token step when posts would move. Needs a connection set to "All workspaces" by an owner or admin.

confirm_token.description: Token from a CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED response, sent after the user confirms.

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string, e.g. a UUID. A retry with the same key within 24 hours returns the first call's result instead of doing it again.

utm_tags.description: false stops adding utm_source, utm_medium and utm_campaign to tracked links opened from captions; true turns it back on. On by default

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.
